title: 5 exercises that can prevent (and relieve!) pregnancy pain
summary: Hemorrhoids, leg cramps, sciatica — oh my! Alongside the joy of pregnancy often comes a parade of physical discomfort. Alleviate and prevent common aches with these exercises.
